notes.title: Knightfall Update 3! New Town, weapons and enchantments!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! Time for update 3 (yes, the actual update 3 this time)[/b]

[h3]New weapons and enchantments:[/h3]

[b]Enchantments: [/b]
Sonar: Reveals enemies in an area around the bullet/bomb impact.
Restoration: Gives you healing bombs or bullets.
Vampirism: Can now also appear as a bomb enchantment and gives the same stats as the weapon enchantment.

[b]Two spellbooks:[/b]
Ice bolt: Launches an ice projectile that slows Enemies that are hit.
Ignite: Fires a volley of projectiles that light enemies on fire when hit.

[h3]New town! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26085258/85c2db9acb33fc92bdc3b148affa68f974a75b73.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26085258/e5cb516cdd37dabe7bdace96b342e09136ad5085.png[/img]

[h3]Patch Notes
[/h3]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new weapons
[*] 2 new weapons enchantments
[*] 3 new bomb enchantments
[*] 1 new town
[*] 2 new spawns
[*] Added the ability to place a marker for your team
[*] Added quality options for models and shadows
[/list]
[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the number of players per match to 28
[*] Changed the Rose Castle and added more paths and rooms
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some performance improvements
[/list]

Make sure to verify the integrity of the game-files!

notes.title: Knightfall Update 2! Performance fixes, new rose castle and more!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! New patch, adding some much-needed performance improvements and a new castle!


[h3]Patch Notes: [/h3]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Two new bomb enchantments
[*] Weapons and enchantments dropping on death
[*] Key bindings
[*] Invert mouse option 
[*] Destructible Barricades
[*] Ability to use firsts after being revived and dropping weapons
Invert mouse option 
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Remade the Rose castle
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements of the player character, the horses and the terrain.
[*] Fixed some arrow desyncing issues of the Bow
[*] Fixed some rose desyncing issues
[*] The menu buttons causing a crash 
[/list]

notes.title: Knightfall Update 1! New weapons and private games! 🏹
notes.notes:
[b]As the disclaimer said we weren't planning on updating Knightfall... But then we couldn't help ourselves! 
[/b]
In this video, you can see a showcase of the new weapons added!

[previewyoutube=weLEB9RPLPw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Patch notes: [/h3]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] 24 players per match
[*] Four new guns
[*] Five enchantments
[*] Crates can spawn in villages and contain enchanted guns
[*] Five gun enchantments
[*] Three bomb enchantments
[*] Hosting private games
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly changed Ending Castle area
[*] Made travel distance between towns shorter
[*] Being far away from your partner will cause you to take damage (like your horse)
[*] Increased the distance you can be away from your horse
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some double playing village sounds
[*] Fixed the crosshair being misrepresentative when riding
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 4 - Some GPU performance fixes, no sound gunshot bug and more!

notes.title: Patch 3: Improved matchmaking, map on horse and gates!

[b]Fixes:[/b]

notes.title: Knightfall: Patch 2 - Go forth without the fort!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! Thank you all for playing, seeing the response to the game has been incredible and we hope to spend the weekend fixing some of the issues you've reported to us. 
[/b]

[b]Patch notes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Removed West Fort and East Fort to allow for bigger battles at the final castle.
[*] Optimized audio implementation performance. This should give players slightly better frame rates
[/list]
[b]
Make sure to restart the game completely and verify the integrity of the game-files in order to recieve the patch! [/b]

notes.title: Knightfall: A Daring Journey Patch 1!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you for playing the game, this is our first patch for Knightfall: A Daring Journey!

We're also looking at making it easier to understand the game as a first-time player for a future patch. 

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Remade some of the roads
[*] Made the days a bit longer
[*] Added wrong-way signs
[*] Renamed Fort to Outpost
[*] Renamed the East and West castles to East and West Fort
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the horse being able to reverse run on grass
[*] Removed friendly fire
[*] Fixed bug where you would sometimes die at the game start
[/list]

Make sure to verify the integrity of the game files!
